battle.name: 改革戰爭
battle.theater: 墨西哥中部普埃布拉州
battle.brief: 改革戰爭起於一八五七年墨西哥自由派憲政與保守派的決裂, 四年後演成內戰與列強干預。線膛口裝野戰砲在戰役中既是遠程火力, 也是守城與圍城的骨幹: 共和軍靠舊式滑膛砲與牛拖輕砲在山區游擊, 法軍則以一八五七年式線膛野戰砲壓制普埃布拉與墨西哥城防線。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰方並非國家對國家, 而是一場由內戰演化成國際衝突的戰爭。墨西哥共和派（自由派、憲政派）以 1857 年憲法為旗, 核心人物是貝尼托·胡亞雷斯; 1858 年失去首都之後, 政府退到墨西哥東南部與太平洋沿岸, 一度以「流亡政府」的形式駐在韋拉克魯斯與薩利納克魯斯, 再遷聖路易斯波托西, 對面是保守派執政的「憲政」政府, 先後由費利克斯·蘇洛阿加、胡安·阿爾蒙特與米格爾·米拉蒙掌權, 最後擁立哈布斯堡王朝的斐迪南·馬克西米利安為墨西哥皇帝。1861 年底西班牙與法國依 1861 年倫敦三國公約出兵, 法軍在貝利西耶爾·巴贊率領下主導對墨作戰, 1864 年後由弗朗索瓦·弗雷伊接掌, 1865 年米格爾·聖安納自流亡返國再統兵。共和派得到美國與英國的外交支持, 卻沒有得到成建制的兵力援助; 保守派與帝國方面則靠法軍、西班牙遠征軍以及大批歐洲雇兵支撐。戰場同時是歐洲列強在美洲的角力場, 法國要把墨西哥變成「拉丁帝國」的構想, 與美國門羅主義及南北戰爭期間的北方政治直接碰撞。
countriesEn: The opposing sides were not state against state but a civil war that turned into an international conflict. The Mexican Republicans (liberals, constitutionalists) fought under the banner of the 1857 Constitution, with Benito Juarez at their centre; after losing the capital in 1858 the government withdrew to south-eastern Mexico and the Pacific littoral, existing for a time as a government in exile at Veracruz and Salina Cruz and later at San Luis Potosi. Opposite them stood the Conservative constitutional government, which passed in turn through Felix Zuloaga, Juan Almonte and Miguel Miramon, and finally installed a Habsburg, Ferdinand Maximilian, as Emperor of Mexico. At the end of 1861 Spain and France intervened under the Tripartite Convention of London of 1861, with the French expeditionary corps under Bazaine taking the lead; Forey succeeded him in 1864, and in 1865 Miguel Santa Anna returned from exile to take command. The Republicans had diplomatic support from the United States and Britain but no formed military aid, while the Conservatives and the Empire relied on French troops, the Spanish expedition and a large influx of European mercenaries. The battlefield was simultaneously a testing ground for the European powers in the Americas: the French design of a Latin Empire in Mexico collided directly with American Monroe Doctrine thinking and with Northern politics during the American Civil War.
people: 關鍵人物分四層。第一層是共和派領袖: 貝尼托·帕布略·胡亞雷斯原為瓦哈卡州法官兼司法部長, 1857 年任內政部長, 在政府崩解後以「憲法總統」身分延續國家權力, 1861 年 7 月正式接任; 伊格納西奧·科蒙福特是首任「憲政總統」, 主持制定 1857 年憲法, 後倒向保守派並辭職; 伊格納西奧·薩拉戈薩在普埃布拉以少數兵力頂住法軍, 一八六二年五月五日之戰即由他指揮; 耶穌·岡薩雷斯·奧爾特加是「東方軍」統帥, 聖托斯·德戈亞多與何塞·馬里亞·阿特雷阿加在西部戰線作戰, 阿特雷加於 1861 年陣亡; 馬里亞諾·埃斯科韋多、萊昂納多·馬爾克斯與托馬斯·蘇亞雷斯分別指揮東方軍、普埃布拉方向與西部援軍。第二層是保守派與帝國方面: 蘇洛阿加、阿爾蒙特與米拉蒙三人輪流執政, 米拉蒙在 1867 年 4 月 11 日陣亡; 馬克西米利安由奧地利派出, 1867 年 6 月 19 日被處決。第三層是干涉者: 巴贊與弗雷伊是法軍兩任駐墨總司令。第四層是外交人物: 美國總統林肯與國務卿西沃德拒絕承認帝國, 派特使布萊恩遊說歐洲; 英國外交大臣帕麥斯頓與俄國的亞歷山大二世同樣不承認, 這些立場最終促成法軍在 1866 至 1867 年間撤出墨西哥。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into four groups. First, the Republican leaders: Benito Pablo Juarez was originally a judge and minister of justice in Oaxaca, became interior minister in 1857, and after the collapse of the government carried on the authority of the state as constitutional president, taking office formally in July 1861; Ignacio Comonfort, the first constitutional president, presided over the drafting of the 1857 Constitution before defecting to the Conservatives and resigning; Ignacio Zaragoza commanded the Mexicans at Puebla, where a small force checked the French on 5 May 1862; Jesus Gonzalez Ortega led the Army of the East, Santos Degollado and Jose Maria Arteaga fought the western theatre, Arteaga falling in 1861, while Mariano Escobedo, Leonardo Marquez and Tomas Suarez commanded the Army of the East, the Puebla flank and the western relief forces respectively. Second, the Conservative and Imperial side: Zuloaga, Almonte and Miramon governed in turn, Miramon being killed on 11 April 1867; Maximilian was sent by Austria and executed on 19 June 1867. Third, the interveners: Bazaine and Forey were the two French commanders in chief in Mexico. Fourth, the diplomats: President Lincoln and Secretary Seward refused to recognise the Empire and sent envoy Blaine to canvass Europe, while Palmerston and Alexander II likewise withheld recognition, positions that in the end helped bring about the French withdrawal in 1866 and 1867.
kits: 卡面這件線膛口裝野戰砲在戰役體系裡的位置, 由整個墨西哥炮兵結構決定。共和軍與保守軍的野戰砲多為拿破崙時代遺留的滑膛青銅砲, 主力是六磅砲與八磅砲, 另配十二磅山炮與四磅山炮, 一律以牛車拖曳; 普埃布拉之戰前線只湊到約十四門野戰砲, 其中數門是被稱為「薩帕特卡斯」的牛拖輕型砲, 由墨軍士兵徒手拉著上陣, 成為整場戰役最出名的裝備細節。線膛口裝砲的價值在射程: 舊式滑膛砲有效射程僅約一千五百公尺, 同期已定型的線膛砲可把同樣藥量的有效射程推到三千公尺以上, 這正是本卡所說「砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵」的意思, 而線膛的真正難處在於後膛與膛壁要承受更高的壓力, 對銅砲與炮架的要求遠高於滑膛時代。法軍在墨西哥的野戰編制已配備一八五七年式八公分口裝線膛野戰砲, 走的是與德國廠商同一條技術路徑; 帝國軍的砲隊則以法製或奧製野戰砲為主, 圍城時另調上二十四磅與三十二磅攻城砲。輕武器方面, 共和軍大量購進美國一八五五年式春田步槍與改成雷管擊發的前裝步槍, 近戰則靠冷矛、馬刀與短柄獵槍; 運輸依賴騾隊、驢車與沿海汽船, 山區道路的狀況決定了砲隊多以牛拖曳而非馬拖曳。
kitsEn: The position of the rifled muzzle-loading field gun shown on the card is decided by the whole Mexican artillery structure. Most field pieces of the Republicans and the Conservatives were Napoleonic-era smoothbore bronzes, mainly 6-pounder and 8-pounder, with 12-pounder and 4-pounder mountain howitzers, all drawn by oxen. On the approaches to Puebla the Mexican front could muster only about fourteen field guns, among them several ox-drawn light pieces known as the Zapatecas, hauled into position by Mexican soldiers on foot, and these became the best-known equipment detail of the whole campaign. The value of the rifled muzzle-loader lies in range: the effective range of the old smoothbore was only about 1,500 metres, whereas the rifled gun of the same generation pushed the effective range of an identical charge beyond 3,000 metres. That is what the card means by saying artillery could win the range contest against infantry for the first time; the real difficulty of rifling is that the breech and the barrel wall must carry far higher pressures, which demands far more from the bronze and the carriage than the smoothbore era ever did. The French field establishment in Mexico already included an 8 cm rifled muzzle-loading field gun of 1857, following the same technical path as the German makers' work, while the Empire's batteries were built around French and Austrian field pieces, with 24-pounder and 32-pounder siege guns called up for the sieges. In light weapons the Republicans bought large quantities of the 1855 Springfield rifle and converted percussion muskets from the United States, with cold lances, sabres and short guns for close work; transport rested on mule trains, donkey carts and coastal steamers, and the state of the mountain roads meant batteries were drawn by oxen rather than horses.
tactics: 共和派在墨西哥中部沒有可與常備軍抗衡的野戰兵力, 因此以游擊與機動作戰為主: 小分隊在米卻肯、格雷羅與瓦哈卡的山區切斷保守軍縱隊與糧道, 破壞道路、襲擊砲隊與徵糧, 平時避免與法軍主力正面交鋒, 只在有利地形攻擊敵軍側翼與掉隊單位, 占領區內由游擊隊維持秩序與徵收糧食, 共和政府再以法例與軍銜把游擊隊納入國家編制, 使其從「匪」變成可以合法作戰的正規部隊。保守派與帝國軍的打法相反: 依託首都、港口與大莊園控制區, 以機動野戰團在高速公路上追擊, 以圍城砲壯大據點, 攻勢常選在雨季與山區補給線較長的季節發動。法軍的戰役方法是典型的海陸合戰: 以汽船運兵, 在維拉克魯斯外海以艦砲封鎖聖胡安·德·烏盧阿要塞, 奪港後沿韋拉克魯斯—哈利帕—普埃布拉—墨西哥城的「皇家道路」行軍, 以集中砲兵火力壓制道路兩側的游擊隊, 並在行軍縱隊前後配置騎兵搜索。普埃布拉之戰最能說明雙方差異: 法軍以密集縱隊沿道路接近, 墨軍把砲隊佈置在城西郊的丘陵地帶, 讓牛拖輕砲在關鍵時刻轉向射擊, 封住法軍縱隊的正面與側翼, 攻守轉折點落在城牆附近的拉諾亞與梅索內斯一帶。圍城則以逐段封鎖、掘壕與定向下砲擊削低城牆, 最終靠夜襲與突擊決定。
tacticsEn: The Republicans had no field force in central Mexico capable of matching a regular army, so their method was guerrilla war and mobility: small detachments in the mountains of Michoacan, Guerrero and Oaxaca cut the Conservative columns and their supply lines, broke up roads, raided batteries and levied grain. They normally avoided meeting the main French body in the open, attacking flanks and stragglers only where the ground favoured them, and in the occupied districts the guerrilla bands kept order and collected provisions; the Republican government then folded the guerrillas into the state's own order through statute and military rank, turning free bands into legally constituted regular troops. The Conservatives and the Empire fought the opposite way, relying on the capital, the ports and the great estates, chasing the enemy with mobile field columns along the trunk roads, and bringing siege guns up to strengthen fixed positions, generally choosing to attack in the rainy season, when the long mountain supply lines worked against the enemy. The French method was classic amphibious operation: troops came by steamer, naval guns sealed the fortress of San Juan de Ulúa off Veracruz, and after taking the port the army marched along the Royal Road from Veracruz through Jalapa and Puebla to Mexico City, concentrating artillery to sweep the guerrillas off both sides of the road, with cavalry screening ahead of and behind the column. The battle for Puebla shows the difference most clearly: the French approached in dense columns along the road, while the Mexicans posted their batteries on the heights west of the city and swung the ox-drawn light guns to fire at the critical moment, sealing the front and flank of the French column, the turning point falling around La Noria and Melesnum by the city walls. Sieges were conducted by cutting off the objective in sections, digging trenches and firing by sections, and were finally decided by night attack and assault.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點。普埃布拉之役 1862 年 5 月 5 日, 法軍投入約六千二百人、二十八門砲, 墨軍約八千人、十四門砲, 墨軍在城西郊的丘陵地帶把法軍縱隊擋在道路與灌溉渠之間, 雙方均有數百人陣亡與受傷。帝國軍其後攻占普埃布拉時以圍城砲火作系統射擊, 城市南門一帶的建築群被夷平。法軍兵力在 1862 年初約一萬二千人, 到 1864 年前後增至約四萬人; 共和派常備軍在同一時期維持約一萬人上下的野戰部隊, 另加數以萬計的游擊隊, 兵力比例在四比一到三比一之間浮動。1867 年 3 月 12 日開始的克雷塔羅圍城戰, 守軍約四千人, 攻城方投入一萬二千至一萬四千人, 圍城歷時約一個月, 城破時守軍連同指揮官一併投降。砲兵指標上, 滑膛六磅砲的有效射程約一千五百公尺, 同期線膛口裝野戰砲最大射程可達三千公尺以上, 這是同樣藥量下射程翻倍的量級。戰爭自 1857 年底起算, 內戰階段約四年, 加上干預階段至 1867 年, 是十九世紀中葉美洲最長的內戰之一。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around a few nodes. At the battle of Puebla on 5 May 1862 the French committed about 6,200 men and twenty-eight guns, the Mexicans about 8,000 men and fourteen guns, the Mexican batteries on the heights west of the city holding the French column between the road and the irrigation ditches, with several hundred killed and wounded on each side. When the Empire later took Puebla the garrison was destroyed by systematic siege fire and the built-up quarter south of the city was levelled. French strength was about 12,000 men at the beginning of 1862 and had risen to roughly 40,000 by 1864; Republican regular forces in the same period numbered about 10,000 men in the field, supplemented by tens of thousands of guerrillas, so the ratio of forces fluctuated between four to one and three to one. In the siege of Queretaro, opened on 12 March 1867, the garrison was about 4,000 men against 12,000 to 14,000 besiegers; the siege lasted roughly a month and ended with the garrison surrendering together with its commanders. On artillery figures, the effective range of a smoothbore 6-pounder was about 1,500 metres, while the maximum range of a rifled muzzle-loading field gun of the same generation exceeded 3,000 metres, which is the order of magnitude by which range doubled on the same charge. Counting from late 1857 the civil war phase ran about four years, and with the intervention phase to 1867 the whole affair was one of the longest civil wars in mid-nineteenth-century America.
cause: 起因是一場憲政衝突。1853 至 1855 年墨西哥在保守派安東尼奧·德·萊昂第二的獨裁統治之下, 天主教會財產與軍隊特權獲得確認, 反對派遭受壓制; 改革派領袖胡亞雷斯在聖路易斯波托西發表「改革宣言」, 這是日後稱為「改革」的那條政治路線的起點。1856 年國會通過「胡亞雷斯法」, 確立民事婚姻、離婚與民事登記, 教會視之為侵入其傳統領域。1857 年 2 月 5 日頒布的墨西哥憲法把自由、平等、教育自由、廢除法人特權、國家無正式宗教等條款寫進根本大法, 立即招致教士、地方地主與軍人的反對。1857 年 12 月 17 日蘇洛阿加發動「塔庫巴亞計劃」, 廢止憲法並接管政府, 自由派軍官同月在薩卡波阿斯特拉起兵, 1858 年 3 月 1 日又在塔巴斯科的馬庫斯帕納再舉義旗, 內戰自此全面鋪開。英國與美國先後承認流亡的自由派政府, 而保守派一度得到英國外交部門的承認; 1861 年美國發生內戰, 華盛頓無力干預, 英國卻在 1861 年 10 月與西班牙及法國達成倫敦三國公約, 給了保守派重新登陸的機會, 衝突於是變成國際戰爭。
causeEn: The cause was a constitutional conflict. Between 1853 and 1855 Mexico was ruled by the Conservative dictatorship of Antonio de Leon II, which confirmed the property of the Catholic Church and the privileges of the army and repressed the opposition; the reform leader Juarez issued the Manifiesto de la Reforma from San Luis Potosi, the point of departure for the line of politics that would afterwards be called the Reform. In 1856 congress passed the Juarez law, establishing civil marriage, divorce and the civil registry, which the Church regarded as an intrusion into its traditional sphere. The Mexican Constitution promulgated on 5 February 1857 wrote freedom, equality, freedom of teaching, the abolition of corporate privilege and the absence of an official religion into the fundamental law, and drew immediate opposition from the clergy, the landed proprietors and the officers. On 17 December 1857 Zuloaga launched the Plan de Tacubaya, voided the Constitution and seized the government; liberal officers rose at Zacapoaxtla in the same month, and on 1 March 1858 the revolt was raised again at Macuspana in Tabasco, and the civil war spread in full. Britain and the United States recognised the exiled liberal government in turn, while the Conservatives were for a while recognised by the British Foreign Office; with the American Civil War breaking out in 1861 Washington could not intervene, yet in October 1861 Britain concluded the Tripartite Convention of London with Spain and France, giving the Conservatives the chance to land again, and the conflict became an international war.
impact: 影響至少有四層。第一, 這場戰爭決定了墨西哥國家的政體走向: 帝國垮台後共和制度恢復, 1857 年憲法連同「改革法令」一路演成 1867 年憲法與 1871、1873 年的改革法令, 成為世俗教育、民事婚姻、平權財產與國家無正式宗教的法律基礎, 也把「改革」與「帝國」塑造成墨西哥近代史上最根本的兩條敘事。第二, 它是歐洲列強在美洲擴張的一次挫敗: 美國自南北戰爭結束後由西沃德把門羅主義寫進外交實踐, 英俄相繼撤銷對帝國的承認, 加上 1866 年紐約會議上法美達成的撤軍協議, 最終使法軍在 1867 年 11 月前離開墨西哥, 這是美國第一次以外交與輿論壓力迫使歐洲列強在美洲退場。第三, 軍事技術上, 線膛口裝野戰砲的成熟、與稜堡火砲的對比, 再加上普埃布拉的射擊運用, 成為歐洲砲兵學術的教材; 牛拖輕砲的機動性也成為各國野戰砲研究的案例。第四, 戰爭的消耗、軍隊的擴張與地方秩序的崩壞, 讓軍人在國家政治中的分量過重, 這條線索最終通向 1876 年的波特菲拉托; 同一場戰爭在美國內戰期間還牽動南方邦聯的棉花外交與北美邊境危機。
impactEn: The consequences run along at least four lines. First, the war settled the constitutional direction of the Mexican state: with the fall of the Empire the republic was restored, and the 1857 Constitution together with the Reform Laws ran on into the Constitution of 1867 and the reform statutes of 1871 and 1873, becoming the legal basis for secular education, civil marriage, equal property and the absence of an official religion, and fixing Reform and Empire as the two founding narratives of modern Mexican history. Second, it was a check to European expansion in the Americas: after the American Civil War Seward carried the Monroe Doctrine into diplomatic practice, Britain and Russia withdrew recognition from the Empire in turn, and the French agreed at the New York conference of 1866 to withdraw their troops, so that the French army left Mexico before November 1867, the first time the United States forced a European power out of the Americas by diplomacy and public opinion alone. Third, in military-technical terms the maturity of the rifled muzzle-loading field gun, its contrast with the fortress gun, and the employment of artillery at Puebla together became textbook material for European artillery scholarship, while the mobility of the ox-drawn light guns became a case study for national field artillery studies. Fourth, the exhaustion of the war, the expansion of the armies and the breakdown of local order gave the military an overweight in national politics, a thread that runs on to the Porfiriato of 1876; the same war also fed Confederate cotton diplomacy and the North American border crisis during the American Civil War.
result: 結果分兩階段。內戰階段, 共和派靠游擊與持久戰耗損保守派, 1861 年 7 月 10 日自由軍攻入墨西哥城, 保守政府崩解, 胡亞雷斯被推舉為憲法總統, 政權退往韋拉克魯斯一帶的流亡據點, 以「東方軍」重建正規軍。干涉階段, 帝國在法軍掩護下站穩腳跟, 1862 至 1864 年相繼攻下普埃布拉與墨西哥城, 一度把共和派壓到太平洋沿岸山區; 但在 1866 年英俄撤銷承認、美國施壓與法軍士氣耗盡的共同作用下, 法軍失去攻勢能力。1867 年 3 月起, 埃斯科韋多與馬爾克斯的兵團合圍克雷塔羅, 4 月 11 日城破, 米拉蒙陣亡, 馬克西米利安於 6 月 19 日被處決, 帝國在墨西哥的實驗徹底終結, 法軍在 1867 年 11 月前全數撤出, 共和政府與修訂後的 1857 年憲法重回國家主導地位。戰役最終以改革派與共和制的勝利告終, 代價則是漫長的動員、財政崩壞與軍人干政的傳統。
resultEn: The outcome came in two stages. In the civil war phase the Republicans wore the Conservatives down through guerrilla war and protracted endurance; on 10 July 1861 the liberal army entered Mexico City, the Conservative government collapsed, Juarez was raised as constitutional president, and the authority withdrew to exile strongholds around Veracruz, where the Army of the East rebuilt the regular army. In the intervention phase the Empire gained its footing under French cover, taking Puebla and then Mexico City between 1862 and 1864 and for a time driving the Republicans back into the Pacific mountains; but with Britain and Russia withdrawing recognition in 1866, American pressure, and French morale exhausted, the French army lost the ability to attack. From March 1867 the columns of Escobedo and Marquez ringed Queretaro: the city fell on 11 April, Miramon was killed, Maximilian was executed on 19 June, the Imperial experiment in Mexico ended for good, and the French army withdrew in full before November 1867, with the Republican government and the amended Constitution of 1857 once more in control of the state. The war ended in victory for the reform and republican side, at the price of protracted mobilisation, ruined finances and a lasting tradition of military intervention in politics.
